Test Description: Assert reset (rst_n=0). Verify awready, wready, bvalid, arready, rvalid are deasserted or in reset state.
Expected Result: Interface resets cleanly; no spurious transfers triggered during reset.

Test Description: Master issues single write transfer with awaddr=0x40001000, wdata=0x12345678, wstrb=4'hF.
Expected Result: awready and wready assert; transaction accepted; bresp returns OKAY (2'b00).

Test Description: Master issues single read transfer with araddr=0x40001000, arprot=3'b000.
Expected Result: arready asserts; rdata returns valid data payload; rresp returns OKAY (2'b00).

Test Description: Perform back-to-back write followed by read to adjacent addresses.
Expected Result: Both transactions complete without bus stall; protocol handshakes adhere to AXI spec.

Test Description: Perform write with byte strobe wstrb=4'b0001 to address 0x40002000.
Expected Result: Target byte lane accepted; remaining lanes masked; bresp returns OKAY.

Test Description: Issue transfer to unmapped address range to verify slave error response handling.
Expected Result: Target slave returns non-OKAY response (SLVERR/DECERR); bus does not deadlock.
